cited.quote: A grant of ₹ 40,000/- each is provided for 500 devotees from Tamil Nadu to perform pilgrimage

rationale: C1 shows only an existing Manasarovar/Mukthinath pilgrimage grant for different destinations and numbers. No extract shows an official step for subsidised pilgrimage to the listed temples with 25 beneficiaries and Rs 25,000. Related activity only.

cited.quote: relocate such markets by providing new and modern markets in phased manner

rationale: C3 is a policy note plan about markets (relocation, securitising rental income); it does not review or revise shop rent slabs. C1 is about livelihood park rents, a different object. No official step on rent slabs.

cited.quote: The concession amount is being reimbursed to the State Transport Undertakings by the Government.

rationale: C5 covers bus travel concessions for students, not metro rail fares. C1 and C2 discuss metro rail projects with no student fare subsidy. No official step for subsidised metro fares for students.

cited.quote: Dr.Dharmam balAmmaiyar Memorial Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme graduates and diploma holders and Rs.25,000/- cash

rationale: C1 (policy note of May 2022) still shows the scheme at Rs.25,000 cash with an 8 gram gold coin; C3 shows the same. No extract shows a raise to Rs 30,000.

cited.quote: proposed to convert 15 posts sanctioned under daily wages in the Government Order second read above

rationale: C2 converts daily-wage posts to contract posts in one project, not permanent employment. C5 and C1 are contract labour rules; C3 extends outsourced workers. None considers permanent employment for 10-year workers.

No extract is about enforcing the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act or child labour. C3 concerns child marriage, C4 plantation workers' schools, C5 COVID orphans' education. None concerns the commitment.

cited.quote: Sathumavu is procured from twenty five Weaning Food Manufacturing Women Industrial Cooperative Societies and two

rationale: C1 describes existing ICDS procurement (cooperatives plus private makers) with no new step. C3 and C5 are GOs on selling millets and palm jaggery through cooperative fair price shops, not procurement for meal centres or hostels. Directional: only continuing activity.

cited.quote: medical care is provided to the insured persons of the ESI Scheme through a network of 223 ESI Dispensaries

rationale: C1 describes the existing ESI network and lists no Tiruppur or Erode ESI hospital. No extract shows any letter, resolution or other formal step urging the Union government on these hospitals.
No extract mentions a three-phase charge of Rs 50 on electricity bills. C2 only lists electricity tax rates, a different levy, and shows no cancellation. Other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: urge the Union Government to make necessary laws and amendments to grant Indian citizenship to Tamil refugees

rationale: C3 (Governor's address) states intent to urge the Union on citizenship, and C2 mentions an announced advisory committee. Neither shows a formal step such as a resolution, letter or GO. Repatriation help in C1 is existing activity.
No extract concerns a tunnel linking Upper Nirar Dam and Nallar-Thirumoorthy Dam. The extracts are canal and tank rehabilitation works and check dams elsewhere.

cited.quote: are laying Re-gasified Liquefied Natural Gas (R-LNG) pipelines from Ennore to Tuticorin

rationale: C2 says IOCL, not the state, is laying the Ennore to Tuticorin R-LNG pipeline, and TANGEDCO is only considering an option for supply. No state step for new pipelines to power houses for 2000 MW. C1 mentions only a possible fuel conversion.

cited.quote: Presently, a monthly pension of Rupees Ten Thousand is being paid to 232 journalists through banks.

rationale: C1 and C2 describe existing journalist pension, family benefit and welfare fund schemes run by the department. No extract shows an independent commission for journalists' welfare or a raised family welfare fund.

cited.quote: to preserve and promote various art forms amongst the younger generations

rationale: C1 and C2 cover folk artists' welfare board and folk art training programmes by cultural centres, not folk arts in the school syllabus. C3 and C4 cover other school education measures. No syllabus step shown.

cited.quote: TANGEDCO Board accorded approval on 29.04.2021 to shift the existing 2x800 MW Uppur STPP to Udangudi site

rationale: C1 and C2 list Udangudi Stage I as an ongoing project with a completion date of 2026-27 and a pre-existing Uppur shift approval of 29.04.2021 (before office). Cheyyur appears nowhere. No new official step to expedite either project.

cited.quote: urge the Union Government to advise the Government of Sri Lanka to ensure that Eelam Tamils

rationale: C1 states intent to urge the Union to advise Sri Lanka on rights; it does not mention asking the Union to appeal to the United Nations, and it is a statement of intent, not a formal step. Nothing else covers it.

cited.quote: Remarriage Assistance Scheme will continue to be implemented without any change

rationale: C1 (Budget 2022-23) says the existing widow-related marriage assistance schemes, including the EVR Maniammaiyar scheme, continue without any change. C2 still shows Rs.25,000 cash for non-graduates with an 8 gram gold coin. No raise to Rs 30,000.

cited.quote: Disciplinary Authority concerned is authorized to dispose the Punishment Rolls which have been issued under rule 3(a)
Cancellation of the Minor punishment to the Police Personnel

rationale: C1 and C2 are G.O.(Ms) No.559 dated 07.12.2021 cancelling minor punishments under rule 3(a) for police personnel following the Chief Minister's announcement; C2 drops pending and current punishment rolls. Operational GO after office was taken.

cited.quote: Orthopedically affected differently abled persons reach their educational institutions/offices or their work spot in time

rationale: C3 shows only the long-running retrofitted petrol scooter scheme (since 2009) for orthopedically affected persons, not a motorised three-wheeler for differently abled students. Related existing scheme only; no new step.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Traders Welfare Board was instituted for implementing several welfare schemes for the traders

rationale: C2 describes the Traders Welfare Board constituted in 1989, an existing board for another group. C1 only gives board procedure rules under safety rules. No extract shows a new welfare board for photographers or videographers.
